key_insight: Solution-phase ligand exchange enables thicker, charge-extracting AgBiS2 nanocrystal films for near-infrared tandem solar cells.
engineering_relevance: One-step deposition of passivated AgBiS2 offers a route toward scalable near-infrared sub-cells paired with visible-light perovskite absorbers.
method: Model tandem performance using the measured AgBiS2 absorption spectrum.
Use solution-phase ligand exchange to passivate nanocrystals and increase usable film thickness.
Integrate AgBiS2 into four-terminal and monolithic perovskite tandems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 24.0% four-terminal tandem efficiency, voltage addition in monolithic tandems, and >90% efficiency retention after three months in dry air without encapsulation; >47.9% triple-junction efficiency is a modeling projection.
watch_item: Dry-air storage stability does not establish durability under illumination, heat, humidity, or outdoor operation.
paper_title: Stable AgBiS2 near-infrared absorbers for thin film tandem photovoltaics
